g.text: Entry into full-time work · ages 22–25 · Q5 versus Q1–Q4
Monthly CPS inputs, quarter-binned estimates. Warm red shows the Q5 contrast; shading gives state-cluster pointwise 95% intervals.
2020–2021 pandemic coefficients are nuisance terms; 2022 uses four season-matched reference quarters. Q4 2026 observes October only.
State-plus-quarter event covariance is indefinite; invalid intervals are withheld separately. These diagnostic curves do not establish AI causality.
